captions.back: Step down, then the other knee

steps.text: Stand tall near a wall or a sturdy chair.
Lift one knee, towards hip height if it is comfortable.
Swing your arms as you march, at a steady pace.
Put the foot down and lift the other knee.

safety: Stay near a wall or a sturdy chair you can hold.
Stop if you feel dizzy or very short of breath.

mistakes.label: low_knee_lift
mistakes.wrong: your knees did not lift high enough
mistakes.right: Lift your knees a little higher, only as far as is comfortable.

mistakes.label: leaning_back
mistakes.wrong: you leaned your upper body backwards
mistakes.right: Stand tall; do not lean backwards.
